from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,platform,sys,re,ast,datetime
from scripts.reading_time import lesson_slices
f=json.loads(Path('docs/course-revision-20261016/freeze-16.json').read_text());p=next(p for p in f['pages'] if p['page_id']=='19.17');live=lesson_slices(Path(p['source']).read_text())['19.17'];print('created_at',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat());print('python_executable',sys.executable);print('python_version',sys.version);print('platform',platform.platform());print('19.17 live slice sha256',hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest(),'freeze matches',hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest()==p['source_sha256']);total=0;errors=[]
for name in ['course/chapters/07.md','course/chapters/09.md','course/chapters/14.md','course/chapters/19.md']:
 text=Path(name).read_text();blocks=list(re.finditer(r'^```python\s*\n(.*?)^```\s*$',text,re.M|re.S));checks=[]
 for i,m in enumerate(blocks,1):
  line=text[:m.start()].count('\n')+2
  try:ast.parse(m.group(1),filename=f'{name}:fence-{i}:line-{line}')
  except SyntaxError as e:errors.append({'path':name,'fence':i,'line':line,'error':str(e)})
  checks.append(line)
 total+=len(blocks);print('AST_PARSE',name,'blocks',len(blocks),'start_lines',checks)
 print('SHA256',name,hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('SHA256 pyproject.toml',hashlib.sha256(Path('pyproject.toml').read_bytes()).hexdigest());print('total_fences',total,'errors',json.dumps(errors,ensure_ascii=False));raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
